metadata.title: Divisorial Rigidity and Regularity of Boundary Cases for the Supercritical LYZ Equation
metadata.abstract: We study the supercritical LYZ equation on compact Kähler manifolds at the boundary of stability. Under numerical semistability, we prove a quantitative positivity estimate on the modified nef cone. It implies that the destabilizing prime divisors form a finite exceptional family. Assuming the existence of a smooth semisubsolution, we prove that the associated intersection form is negative definite on the span of classes of these divisors. Using this rigidity, we then construct a logarithmic singular subsolution along their union and obtain a bounded Bedford--Taylor solution which is smooth on its complement.
